a1_first128_context.interpretation: A1+A2 (K256) is a first-128 subset context comparison; it is not a full-256 comparison.

fit_exposure.recipe: continued_fixed_readout; fixed public E; base logits reused; residual bottleneck 512; cross entropy; AdamW foreach=False; learning rate 0.0002; CosineAnnealingLR T_max=13000; 512 position draws per update; record batch size 8; weight decay 0; paired fit seed 4010.
fit_exposure.replacement_step_meaning: Schedule exposure flags for batches with fewer than 512 eligible positions; not fit retries or weight replacements.

interpretation: B1 improves B0 in all four full-256 cells: exact-record gains are 97, 94, 166, and 161 with zero losses in the Finance-base, Finance-LoRA, Pile-base, and Pile-LoRA cells respectively.
The token-accuracy gains are positive in all four cells, with the largest gains on Pile.

On the shared first-128 subset, B1 remains below A1+A2 (K256) in all four cells; the deficit is small on Finance and larger on Pile. This is a subset contrast and does not compare B1 full-256 denominators directly with A1+A2.

The result is a reproduced gain for the new unused-source replication. It is not an overall replacement claim, a seed-reliability claim, or an attribution of differences from PR20 entirely to bias or training variation.
A1+A2 rank diagnostics are aggregate-only; proposal omission and selected-wrong counts are reported, and causal A2 decoder ranking is unavailable.
